exam.name: Anthropic Claude Code Certification
exam.notes: Starter prep path — item list is under review against the official Anthropic exam blueprint. Verify the official registration page and domains before relying on this.

items.title: Install & set up Claude Code
items.desc: Install Claude Code (and iTerm2 on macOS). Know how to launch it and run the basic loop.

items.title: How we work with AI at Solvd
items.desc: Why AI fails the way it does and the core principles. Orientation before the tool specifics.

items.title: Claude Code best practices (reference)
items.desc: Modes, slash commands, @-references, MCP, custom commands. Skim now; return per section.

items.title: Read before you write
items.desc: Use Claude Code to explain an unfamiliar file before changing it. Confirm claims against the code.

items.title: Diff review discipline
items.desc: Generate a change and review the diff hunk-by-hunk; reject overcomplicated output and ask for simpler.

items.title: Plan mode for multi-file work
items.desc: Use Plan mode before a multi-file edit; verify the plan before executing.

items.title: A good CLAUDE.md (golden example)
items.desc: Annotated exemplar CLAUDE.md — what to include, what to leave out.

items.title: Write a CLAUDE.md for a repo
items.desc: Author a focused CLAUDE.md for a project you know; keep it tight.

items.title: Settings, permissions & hooks
items.desc: Understand settings.json, permission modes, and hooks at a level you can explain.

items.title: What MCP is and when to use it
items.desc: MCP servers/tools and how Claude Code consumes them.

items.title: Wire up one MCP server
items.desc: Connect a single MCP server and call one of its tools from Claude Code.

items.title: Subagents & custom commands
items.desc: How subagents and reusable slash commands multiply output.

items.title: Build one automated feedback loop
items.desc: Set up a loop where Claude Code runs tests/lint and self-corrects.

items.title: Confirm exam format & registration
items.desc: Read the official exam page: format, domains, cost, eligibility. Update this path if it differs.

items.title: Timed mock run
items.desc: Do a timed self-quiz across the domains above; note weak spots and revisit.

items.title: Take the certification exam
items.desc: The finish line: register and sit the exam.
